description.p: Quo is an AI assistant that runs open models on your own computer. Once a model is downloaded, Quo works with no internet and needs no account. Nothing you type leaves your computer unless you choose a cloud model.

ul.li: Chat, ask about documents and photos, and talk instead of typing
Open models from Qwen, Gemma, Llama, Phi and Ministral, chosen to fit your computer’s memory
Runs on your graphics card with Vulkan, or on the processor
Search Hugging Face and run almost any GGUF model, or use the models you already have from LM Studio or Ollama
Make and change pictures on your own graphics card
Code mode: a coding agent that works in a project folder you choose
Cloud models when you want them, always marked, with one free every day

description.p: Code mode runs commands and git on your computer, outside Flatpak’s sandbox, and only after you approve each one in a window of its own. Quo is free and open source.

screenshot.caption: Chat with a model on your own computer, with Wi-Fi off
Code mode works in a project folder and asks before it commits

description.p: The first Flatpak of Quo, built entirely from source.

ul.li: Claude Agent: use Claude with your own Claude Code sign-in
llama.cpp 1.0, with faster replies on the graphics card
Pictures made on your computer use the newest stable-diffusion.cpp
